scope_note: Only facts verifiable offline (this session's fetches + repository inspection) are marked verified. Everything else is explicitly UNVERIFIED and must be confirmed against official docs or a sandbox before it is used as acceptance evidence. Per design D32-14, conflicts resolve to the re-check and are written back to the docs.

channels.implementation_effect: single chat and group chat only; the 'channel/guild' scenario is out of scope (sending there requires an online WebSocket). Anchor binding is explicit registration: obtaining an openid needs an event subscription (WebSocket, or a public webhook), and the standard library has no WebSocket client, so automatic binding is deferred rather than adding a dependency. This corrects the design's 'bind_qq_bot() starts an event subscription' wording.
